general_sentiment.text:
I've been trading memecoins since 2023 and I've never seen a tool like this.

If you're not using it yet, i don't know what you're doing in this space.

Most rugs don't look like rugs.

The chart looks fine.
The holder list looks spread out.
20 different wallets, 20 different people.

Except it's not 20 people.

It's one guy with 20 wallets, waiting for you to buy so he can sell everything into you.

There's a tool that shows you this in 15 seconds.

It's called CrawlScan: [https://t.co/iIbcMWWSIy]

You paste a token address and a swarm of crawlers goes through every top holder onchain and checks things nobody looks at:

> Who actually bought and who just received tokens from someone

> Which wallets are brand new and never traded anything before this coin

> Who sniped the launch in the first seconds and is still sitting on the bag

> Which wallets are secretly linked: same transaction, same funder, same distributor, tokens passed between them, packs of fresh wallets buying in the same block

Then it merges linked wallets into real people and tells you how far the price could fall if the biggest one sells.

Not "this cluster holds 12%".
Actual price impact on a chart.

You get a score from 0 to 100 and a clear verdict before you put a single dollar in.

And it keeps getting better.

When a setup looks like a rug, you get an early warning right on the chart, with how deep the drop could go and exactly which wallets are behind it.

You can see the first 20 buyers after launch and whether they're still holding or already cashed out.

And if several of them sent their tokens to the same wallet, it shows you that too.

There's a live feed of everything the community is scanning right now.

And a Telegram bot: [https://t.co/aNQ580bjTS]

Send it a contract, get the verdict in seconds, or add it to your group so the whole chat sees who's really holding before anyone apes.

Works on Robinhood Chain and Solana.

Free.
No wallet connect.
The code is fully open source on dev's GitHub.

The craziest part: this thing is only a few days old.

The dev @0x_Punisher shipped all of this almost back to back, and the updates keep coming.

Nothing else I've used shows you the connections between wallets like this.

If you trade memecoins, scan before you buy.

It takes 15 seconds and can save you from the coin that takes your whole bag.

Huge work done, big shoutout ot dev.

Using it every time before scanning any memecoin now.

Btw native robinhood:0x19dcb63c4d2f29a6f077f094a4f858fc790145e1 token looks like this early gem that will go parabolic.

Not sure why this tech is not sitting at millions yet.

Looks like super early gem you'll be showing your friends after it goes parabolic one day.

Bidding here, based dev + crazy tech is all that's needed to 100x from here.

Thank me later.
